protocol: First reproduce all original mixture probabilities and cutoff decisions in all three roles. Only then infer each exact original component alone at its original crop, component normalization/gain and global mixture gain. No fit or threshold change.
unit: One distinct expected pitch in each sampled mixture; same-pitch components count once, found alone if any own component supplies that pitch.

states.retained: Own component found alone and pitch found in mixture
states.emerged_after_sum: No own component found alone, pitch found in mixture
states.lost_after_sum: Own component found alone, pitch absent in mixture
states.already_missing_alone: No own component found alone and pitch absent in mixture

strata: strongest own-component RMS relative to loudest component: 0..-6/-6..-12/-12..-18/below-18 dB
limits: Original intended labels are retained; annotation does not guarantee the intended pitch is audible in every crop.
Mixture effects include feature normalization, phase interaction and classifier context; loss after summation does not by itself isolate physical masking.
An extra pitch present in a solo is an association, not proof that the component caused the mixture extra.
These source-disjoint roles have already been used for development; recording pass, protocol and content remain confounded.
Sampled sustained pitch sets do not measure string assignment, attacks/releases, native timing, MIDI delivery or live readiness.
The frozen model remains rejected. No fit, cutoff retune, exclusion, official-score rewrite, continuous replay or installed/default change.
scope: One CPU GitHub observation, existing authorized inputs only; bulk remains remote.
